title: Frame With Name 🖼️
excerpt: A massive Friends Remover update is here! Introducing Profile Frames, Compact Viewer, Removal Ranks, Friend History, improved scheduled removals, smarter pin suggestions, redesigned status toasts, new FR Plus themes, and major performance and stability improvements.
body: Friends Remover 2.1 brings a massive collection of new features, improvements, fixes, and performance upgrades. This update introduces Profile Frames, Removal Ranks, Friend History, improved scheduled removals, redesigned status notifications, new FR Plus themes, and many improvements across the Compact Viewer, Friends List, pinning system, and background systems.

added.moreInfo: View your friends' Roblox profile frames directly in Friends Remover. Friends Remover has its own implementation, with frames converted into a square format for the Compact Viewer. Profile Frames can be enabled or disabled in Settings and are enabled by default. The frames are designed to fully match Roblox's profile frames.

View a friend's Friends Remover removal rank if they have used Friends Remover. The more friends they have unfriended, the higher their rank. Removal Ranks are available in Friends Details and the Compact Viewer.

FR Plus users can view a friend's unfriend history directly from the Compact Viewer or Friends Details. Users can choose whether their unfriend history can be viewed by friends through the privacy settings.
Added direct actions to the Compact Viewer header for Select All, Deselect All, and Refresh Friends List. These actions have been moved out of the three dots menu.
Added the tutorial back with smoother animations and new steps.
Added back the classic removal confirmation toast: "Tap to confirm removal of name (12% of your friends list)."
Replaced the old FR Plus themes with new special themes.
Added a new free yellow theme, which is now the default theme.

removed.moreInfo: Removed custom intervals for background removals.
The Friends List view no longer displays account badges.

removed.text: Premium, Verified, Roblox Plus, and Admin Badge Requests
removed.moreInfo: The Friends List view no longer requests Premium, Verified, Roblox Plus, or Admin badge data.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed an issue where the Roblox Plus logo and Roblox Admin logo were swapped in White Mode.
Fixed the FR Plus grant notification appearing repeatedly.
Fixed friend sorting in the Compact Viewer sometimes breaking.
Fixed scheduled friends being vulnerable to removal. Scheduled friends are now protected by multiple removal systems, including background removal.
Scheduled friends can no longer be pinned through the Friends List Viewer.
Scheduled friends can no longer be selected or removed through the Friends List Viewer.
Fixed Bio sometimes appearing in the Compact Viewer or Friends Details instead of Friends Since.
Fixed the Mutual Friend Viewer search behavior so it continues working correctly while searching and removes the current search when opened.
Fixed multiple issues affecting refreshing, selecting, and removing friends.
Fixed stability issues when switching views and reopening the popup.

improved.moreInfo: Updated the background settings poller for improved performance and reliability.
Updated background removal polling times for improved performance and reliability.
Updated the loading screen with a centered layout and a larger headshot.
Increased the maximum number of pin suggestions from 3 to 5 and increased the suggestion percentage from 5% to 25%.
Free users must now be friends with someone for 3 full days before they can pin them.
Friend statuses are now displayed separately below the headshot, similar to names.
Made the Compact Viewer more compact, bringing names and the friend count such as "2/200" closer together so everything can be viewed without scrolling.
Moved name badges closer to names. After multiple updates and adjustments, this positioning is now final.
The name badge index is no longer displayed above the three dots modal.
Updated the untrust system so it now displays a toast notification.
Scheduled removals can now be scheduled up to 20 days ahead.
Scheduled friends will still be processed even when the user is not logged into the correct account.
Updated status notifications with better descriptions and status colors that match the current friend status.
Dark Mode is now the default theme.
Improved overall performance, making Friends Remover run more smoothly while reducing lag and unnecessary background activity.
Improved friend-list loading speed.
Improved background performance and reduced unnecessary background activity.
Improved performance when working with large friend lists.
Improved stability when switching views and reopening the popup.
Search queries in the Compact Viewer and Friends List are now cached.
The Mutual Friend Viewer continues to work while searching and automatically removes the current search when opened.
Improved how friend information is loaded, displayed, and handled throughout Friends Remover.
Improved profile frame integration across the Compact Viewer and Friends Details.
Improved overall stability across Friends Remover, including friend loading, selection, removal, view switching, and background processes.
